answer: Coordination Horizon Escrow. Each agent identity posts a per-task escrow that vests only after its sponsored sub-agents finish tasks inside a shared work island. Crossing the escrow horizon requires every sub-agent to complete tasks sequentially; parallel identities stall because unused slots expire. An attacker flooding N identities pays N times the escrow plus shale-slow serial completion, making sybil fleets cost superlinearly in time and capital per useful task.
